why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Karrier One app The homepage points to the Karrier One app for phone service and mobile data. Get it from the mobile page .

2 Step 2 : Find the wallet in the app The token page points to a wallet section in the app, described as a payment flow tied to a phone number on Sui, with a Download the app button. The app is on the mobile page .
3 Step 3 : Check the dashboard login The dashboard login is for people who already run Karrier One hardware, who manage their devices and earnings there.
4 Step 4 : Look at the network on the explorer The Karrier One explorer shows active deployments and coverage areas of the network.
5 Step 5 : Read the documentation The Karrier One docs cover the network, the wallet and dashboard support, and the KONE token FAQ.
